name: Hushai
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy

points: David and his men went by the way while Shimei went along the hillside cursing, throwing stones, and casting dust; and they came weary and refreshed themselves. Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him. When Hushai the Archite, David's friend, came to Absalom saying, God save the king, Absalom asked why he went not with his friend, and Hushai answered that he would serve whom the Most High and Israel chose, and would serve in the presence of the son as he served the father.

note.label: 2 Samuel 16: Ziba, Shimei's Cursing, and Absalom Defiles the Concubines

points: Hushai put into action the plan he and David made. Absalom challenged him, asking, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? Why wentest thou not with thy friend? This is a real friend, not a friendish one; a true friend tells you when you are wrong and full of it, not the one who only strokes your head and pats your back like Absalom did to steal the people's hearts.

note.label: 2 Samuel 16: Ziba, Shimei's Cursing, and Absalom Defiles the Concubines

points: Absalom wanted a second opinion, so he called Hushai the Archite to hear likewise what he would say. There is safety in a multitude of counselors, but only where the counsel is according to thus saith the Lord; a counselor who does not go to the scriptures is not one you should want.

note.label: 2 Samuel 17: The Counsel of the Lord Shall Stand

points: Hushai told Absalom that Ahithophel's counsel was not good at this time. He reminded him that his father and his mighty men were mighty and chafed in their minds as a bear robbed of her whelps, war ready and strategic, and that David would not lodge with the people but move by night.

note.label: 2 Samuel 17: The Counsel of the Lord Shall Stand

points: Absalom and all the men of Israel said Hushai's counsel was better than Ahithophel's. The Lord had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that He might bring evil upon Absalom. The Lord was working with Hushai and David, while Satan was in the spirit of Absalom and Ahithophel.

note.label: 2 Samuel 17: The Counsel of the Lord Shall Stand
